subject: Shared home-office layouts
hook: Two people, one office: pick the layout before the desk.
ig:
Two people, one office: pick the layout before the desk. Here's how to decide.

Sharing a home office works brilliantly or terribly, and the layout is usually why.

Start with calls. Whoever spends the most time on video gets the seat with a plain wall behind and the door out of shot.

Then choose between:
— Side by side on one wall: easiest fit, shared storage, but you'll hear each other
— Back to back on opposite walls: more private for calls, but needs a wider room

Whichever you choose, give each person their own drawers, share one shelf for the printer, and plan power and a cable route at both seats.

A fitted home office desk can be made to the exact width of the wall, so two workstations fit where two freestanding desks wouldn't.

Save this for your planning, and tap the link in bio to see our home office desks.
